controls.requirement_text: Do not receive any consideration (remuneration or compensation, in any form) from any person other than the client being advised, in respect of the underlying products or securities advised on.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 34(4) bars consideration from anyone other than the advised client for the underlying products.
controls.question_primary: Do you have controls ensuring no consideration is taken from anyone other than the advised client?
controls.question_why: Third-party payments are the classic distortion of independent advice.
sufficiency_questions: Is consideration taken only from the advised client?
Are third-party payments on advised products excluded?

controls.requirement_text: Maintain an arm's-length relationship between advisory and other activities; provide advisory and distribution through a separately identifiable department/division with separate manpower; and maintain client-level segregation for advisory and distribution.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 34(5),(10),(11) require arm's-length separation of advisory from other activities, a separate advisory division and client-level segregation.
controls.question_primary: Do you keep advisory at arm's length from distribution, with a separate division and client-level segregation?
controls.question_why: Blending advice and distribution is where suitability quietly bends toward commission.
sufficiency_questions: Is advisory separated from distribution (division and manpower)?
Is client-level segregation maintained?

controls.requirement_text: Do not deal on own account contrary to advice given to clients for 15 days from such advice (subes to the 24-hour revised-assessment carve-out), and do not knowingly trade against a client on own account.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 34(6)-(7) restrict own-account dealing contrary to client advice for 15 days and prohibit knowingly trading against a client.
controls.question_primary: Do you have controls preventing own-account dealing contrary to your client advice (the 15-day rule)?
controls.question_why: Trading against your own advice is a direct conflict and a market-integrity breach.
sufficiency_questions: Is own-account dealing barred for 15 days after contrary advice (with the revised-assessment carve-out)?
Are you prevented from knowingly trading against a client?

controls.requirement_text: Operate a risk-profiling process (obtain client information, assess risk willing and able to take, communicate the profile, update periodically) and ensure all advice is suitable to the client's risk profile and consistent with objectives and financial position.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 34(8)-(9) require risk profiling and suitability of advice to the client's profile, objectives and financial position.
controls.question_primary: Do you risk-profile clients and ensure advice is suitable to their profile and objectives?
controls.question_why: Unsuitable advice is the core investor-protection failure the Authority tests for.
sufficiency_questions: Is a documented risk-profiling process run and updated periodically?
Is advice checked for suitability to the profile and objectives?

controls.condition: you provide implementation services to advisory clients
controls.requirement_text: Where implementation services are provided, adequately disclose any conflicts of interest and charge fees only pursuant to an agreement, disclosed transparently, with the client under no obligation to avail such services.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 34(12)-(13) permit implementation services subject to conflict disclosure, agreed transparent fees and no client obligation to avail.
controls.question_primary: Do you provide implementation services to your advisory clients?
controls.question_why: Implementation for advisory clients is permitted only on clean, disclosed, no-compulsion terms.
sufficiency_questions: Are conflicts disclosed and fees charged per a transparent agreement?
Is availing implementation optional for the client?

controls.requirement_text: Seek client information on financial situation, investment experience and objectives and keep it confidential; make adequate material disclosures; and ensure fees charged are fair and reasonable.
controls.regulatory_basis: Schedule II Part B(G)(1)-(3) require gathering and protecting client information, adequate disclosures and fair, reasonable fees.
controls.question_primary: Do you gather and protect client information, disclose adequately and charge fair fees?
controls.question_why: These conduct basics round out the adviser's fiduciary posture.
sufficiency_questions: Is client information gathered and kept confidential?
Are disclosures adequate and fees fair and reasonable?

controls.requirement_text: Maintain written internal policies and control procedures governing employee dealing/trading that address conflicts of interest, promote objective and reliable research reflecting an unbiased view, and prevent use of research to manipulate the market, proportionate to the nature, scale and complexity of the business.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(1)-(3) require written policies/controls on employee dealing that manage conflicts, promote objectivity and prevent research-based manipulation.
controls.question_primary: Do you have written policies/controls governing employee dealing that protect research objectivity?
controls.question_why: Objectivity controls are what separate credible research from marketing dressed as research.
sufficiency_questions: Do policies address conflicts and promote objective research?
Are they proportionate and enforced?

controls.requirement_text: Maintain appropriate mechanisms and robust, effective barriers to ensure the independence and objectivity of research activities from the entity's other business dealings and those of its group entities.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(4),(9) require mechanisms and barriers ensuring research independence from other and group-entity business.
controls.question_primary: Do you have barriers ensuring research independence from your other and group-entity business?
controls.question_why: Without information barriers, research bends to the firm's other commercial interests.
sufficiency_questions: Are barriers in place separating research from other business?
Do they extend to group-entity dealings?

controls.requirement_text: Establish and enforce personal-trading policies for analysts and their associates (monitored, recorded and subject to formal approval where necessary), ensuring an analyst does not trade contrary to outstanding recommendations except with prior written approval.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(5)-(7) require personal-trading controls preventing analysts from trading contrary to their recommendations without prior written approval.
controls.question_primary: Do you monitor analyst personal trading and prevent trading contrary to outstanding recommendations?
controls.question_why: Analysts trading against their own calls is a classic front-running/abuse pattern.
sufficiency_questions: Is analyst personal trading monitored and recorded?
Is contrary trading barred without prior written approval?

controls.requirement_text: Structure analyst remuneration to avoid any bias in research analyses and recommendations.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(8) requires analyst remuneration structured to avoid bias.
controls.question_primary: Is analyst remuneration structured to avoid bias in research?
controls.question_why: Remuneration tied to deal outcomes quietly corrupts the research view.
sufficiency_questions: Is remuneration insulated from specific research outcomes/deals?

controls.requirement_text: Do not provide any promise or assurance of favourable review in a research report as consideration to commence or influence a business relationship or to receive compensation or other benefits.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(10) prohibits promises of favourable review for business or compensation.
controls.question_primary: Do you have controls against promising favourable research in exchange for business or benefits?
controls.question_why: Selling favourable coverage destroys the integrity of the research franchise.
sufficiency_questions: Are favourable-review promises prohibited and monitored?

controls.requirement_text: Ensure report information is complete, concise and specific on conflicts and their likely impact, and disclose any material interest, including financial interest, 1%+ beneficial ownership, material business relationship in the past 12 months and other conflicts relating to the subject company.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(11)-(12) require complete conflict information and disclosure of material/financial interests, 1%+ ownership and business relationships.
controls.question_primary: Do your reports disclose material and financial interests, 1%+ holdings and relevant business relationships?
controls.question_why: Undisclosed interest in the subject company is the most scrutinised research failing.
sufficiency_questions: Are conflicts and their impact stated in the report?
Are financial interest, 1%+ ownership and business relationships disclosed?

controls.requirement_text: Base facts in research reports on reliable information, define terms used in recommendations and use them consistently, and maintain an adequate documentary basis supported by research for each report.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(13)-(14) require reliable factual bases, consistently defined terms and adequate documentary support for reports.
controls.question_primary: Do your reports rest on reliable information with a documented research basis and consistent terms?
controls.question_why: A report without a documentary basis cannot be defended if challenged.
sufficiency_questions: Are facts based on reliable, sourced information?
Is there an adequate documentary basis and consistent terminology?

controls.condition: you employ a rating system in your research reports
controls.requirement_text: Where a rating system is employed, clearly define the meaning of each rating, including the time horizon and the benchmarks on which the rating is based.
controls.regulatory_basis: Regulation 36(15) requires clear definition of each rating's meaning, time horizon and benchmarks where a rating system is used.
controls.question_primary: Do you employ a rating/recommendation system in your research?
controls.question_why: Undefined rating meanings mislead readers about what a call actually signals.
sufficiency_questions: Is each rating's meaning, time horizon and benchmark clearly defined?

controls.requirement_text: Ensure the entity, its employees and research analysts do not engage in insider trading, front-running, or front-running of its own research report, and maintain confidentiality of a report until it is made public.
controls.regulatory_basis: Schedule II Part B(J)(3)-(4) prohibit insider trading and front-running of research and require confidentiality until publication.
controls.question_primary: Do you have controls against front-running of research and leakage of reports before publication?
controls.question_why: Pre-publication leakage and front-running are among the gravest research abuses.
sufficiency_questions: Are front-running and insider trading of research prevented?
Is report confidentiality maintained until publication?
